test.name: Spec 0013 full verify: Diagnostics clears the last error after reconnecting

expected: After Stackly reconnects to stacklyd, the Diagnostics Connection section shows Last error None and no What to do hint, as it does when it connects on the first try.
actual: After reconnecting, Diagnostics kept the error from before the connection. Status and footer read `stacklyd degraded` (connected; the dev daemon has no catalog), but Last error still read `ipc.endpoint_missing · unavailable · no socket at the daemon path` and What to do read `stacklyd isn’t running. Start it with stacklyd, then click Reconnect.`; Copy Details copied the same lines. The same happened after an untrusted socket: once connected, What to do still read `Other users can access the socket. Stackly sent nothing to this socket.` A launch with stacklyd already running showed `Last error: None` and no What to do row. DaemonModel sets lastError on unreachable, untrusted, and incompatible and never clears it on connected.
steps: on commit 2239e01 with a clean tree: `cargo build -p stacklyd -p stackly-cli -p stackly-fake-server`, `cargo xtask build-app` (Debug), a temporary STACKLY_ROOT under the session scratchpad, and the app started from target/xcode/Build/Products/Debug/Stackly.app/Contents/MacOS/Stackly with that root

Claude Code read and pressed elements with a small AXUIElement tool (tree dump, AXPress on buttons and menu items, AXSelected on sidebar rows, AXSize on the window) and took window screenshots with `screencapture -l`; no keystrokes were sent
launch with no stacklyd, open Diagnostics: Last error `ipc.endpoint_missing`, What to do `stacklyd isn’t running…`
start `target/debug/stacklyd` with the same root; the app connected by itself within 8 s; read the Connection rows and pressed Copy Details (clipboard saved and restored around the read)
stop stacklyd with SIGTERM, start it again, press Stackly › Reconnect to stacklyd: same stale rows

relaunch with stacklyd running and its socket at mode 0666 (banner `Stackly didn’t connect to stacklyd.`), `chmod 600` the socket, press Reconnect in the banner: connected, What to do still names the untrusted socket
reviewer: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) as the checker of the full verify session chk-f13-verify drove the app through the accessibility API and read the screenshots and daemon logs it took; the user has not reviewed this record
